# Connected Clause

Connects the exact clause's named actions to native sources and callable workflows. Clause bindings can override type defaults and supply action connections or documented property values. Actions can listen for initialization, activation, document changes, events, embedded documents, collection members, named channels and timers. A workflow selects the configured party or channel and can require the exact reviewed document version.

A connection with `profile` uses a named object in the clause's `parameters.connectionProfiles`. The profile can supply `params` and `when`. The connection keeps its individual source declaration and other supported fields. A local `params` or `when` conflicts with using a profile. Without a profile the ordinary connection fields apply. An accepted local outcome follows the declared action contract and connected source. Separate sources determine external outcomes.
